'''Einion Avharin''' is one of three famous [[First Counsel]]s from [[Far Madding]].

== History ==
A statue of Einion has been erected in Far Madding, in the Avharin Market named after her, and points toward the [[Caemlyn]] Gate.{{ref/book|9|23}} A [[Murandian]] [[noble]] by the name of [[Segan do Avharin a'Roos]] shares a name with her.{{ref/book|8|17}}
